text:
Alex G.: Hey team — first day! Need Datadog/Grafana/Sentry access for EU onboarding. My email is alex.g@redwood.ai. Specifically I need the payments-service overview dashboard, api-latency panels, and the payment error-rate alert runbook. Who do I ping for access?
Jules (DevEx): Welcome! :wave: Quick path: Okta → Groups → add yourself to observability-readers to get Datadog/Grafana view perms. For Sentry you'll need to be added to the 'payments' project. If the Okta group is missing ping me here.
Alex G.: I don't see observability-readers in my Okta groups — UI shows "No groups available" under My Groups.
Nina (Platform): Alex — which team and org id are you on? We have separate EU namespaces so I can check provisioning.
Alex G.: Team: Payments Platform. Org id: redwood-eu-prod.
infra-bot: Automated invite: Datadog invite sent to alex.g@redwood.ai (expires in 48h). Track at https://idp.redwood/invites/1799154321
Jules (DevEx): If Okta doesn't show the group, open a request at https://go.redwood/identity-requests with scope: grafana:viewer, datadog:standard, sentry:member and paste the request ID here. I can fast-track once I see it.
Alex G.: Request submitted: ID REQ-202903 — pasted the link in the ticket.
Maya (Eng): I can add you to the Grafana dashboard right now. Dashboard slug: dashboards/payment-overview. If you need edit perms say so. To verify via API you can run:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAF_TOKEN" https://grafana.internal/api/dashboards/uid/payment-overview
```
security-bot: Security policy reminder: EU onboarding requires MFA + device approval. Make sure Okta Verify is enabled and your device is approved under policy 'eu-strict'.
Jules (DevEx): Sentry invite sent — check spam if you don't see it in primary inbox. Re-issuing in 10m if no ack.
Alex G.: Got Datadog email and Sentry invite, and I can view the payment-overview dashboard in Grafana now.
Maya (Eng): Added runbook link to the error-rate alert panel: https://runbooks.redwood/payments/error-rate. Also added a short note on what to do for a transient spike.
Alex G.: Perfect — I can see the runbook and the alert annotations. Thanks everyone :tada: 
Jules (DevEx): Nice, welcome aboard again. If you want a quick walkthrough of key dashboards later today ping me and I can screen-share for 15m.
Alex G.: Will do, appreciate it!
